extend_action_space: extend the HabitatSimActions singleton action space by registering a new action name and returning its integer id
has_action: check if a named action is already registered in the HabitatSimActions singleton
get_action_id_by_name: get the integer id for a registered action name using attribute or item access on HabitatSimActions
list_all_actions: iterate over all registered action names in the HabitatSimActions singleton using its iterator protocol
count_registered_actions: get the total number of registered actions in the HabitatSimActions singleton using len
